title: Satori business app queue
description: Writes a queue, queues/<id>.json: a page provider's records, with columns, a sort, a page size and facets, and its name and its facets' names in labels/en.json.

package.description: The app definition package, as a path from the workspace root, such as business-apps/packages/acme-contracts.

id.description: The queue's id, which is its file name and what the menu and the home name: 1 to 64 letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

pageProvider.description: The page provider on the server whose records the queue lists. A queue has no open record, so it should need no parameter, or take literals written by hand.

columns.description: The columns, <prefix>:<name> each, separated by commas. Defaults to dc:title,dc:modified.

label.description: The queue's name in English. Defaults to its id, humanized.

facets.description: The facets that filter the list, separated by commas: each an aggregate the page provider defines, by its id, or by the property it groups by, <prefix>:<name>, such as claim:status for claim_status_agg, as app-model's aggregates are named. A page provider of the package's own is read, and an aggregate it does not define is refused, naming those it does. On the server's page provider an id is written unchecked, and a property is refused: give the id describe_page_provider lists. Each facet's name is a label key, <app>.facet.<aggregate>, with its English text in labels/en.json.

force.description: Write the queue again if it exists, replacing its page provider and columns, and its sort, page size and facets when given. What else it has is kept: parameters, facets when not given, row and bulk actions, visibleWhen, and the widget of a facet on an aggregate given again. Its labels keep the texts labels/en.json has.
